bullets: Fixed a bug where a background launcher update could release your Freebuff session, dropping you back on the paid model picker; the session now survives an automatic update.
Added deferred self-update installs, so a downloaded background update waits until you close your CLI session instead of interrupting or restarting the running assistant.
Preserved chat history when a session is aborted or times out and you immediately restart, instead of wiping the conversation.
Added an H key history shortcut and read-only chat view for browsing past transcripts without disrupting a running session.
Tied the first-tab discount to the live session owner's purchase account, so CLI users see the correct discount instead of a misreported legacy price.
Fixed crash recovery for Freebuff CLI hours, so reopening the app after an unexpected close resumes the in-progress paid session instead of charging for a new hour.
Re-added Solar Pro 4 to the free model picker and removed its auto-rewrite to Solar Mini 4, so saved Pro 4 choices stay on Pro 4.
Updated the sponsored-run flow to edit your working copy in place, so sponsored tasks change your files directly with no branch or commit and you undo them with a single command.
Changed the sponsored compute grant deadline to start counting from when the run actually begins, giving the full run window instead of counting down from Accept.
Rewrote the sponsored run prompt so the task procedure is stated as the only goal and recent messages are marked as read-only background context.
